project.name: Vibe-Trading
project.read_scope: Static read-only review of frontend routes, navigation, page components, shared page components, and the UI tool/action labels. No dependencies installed, services started, tests run, or credentials inspected.
project.identity_note: The local upstream copy has no Git metadata. All 2544 pinned archive members match this copy by SHA256/size. Frontend reference files are separately hashed; package version alone is not a commit identity.

major_user_operations: Create and switch chat sessions; reopen, rename, and delete sessions from the shared sidebar.
Send follow-up prompts with streaming output; stop a live response, retry failed messages, continue a timed-out activity, reconnect to a running activity, and export the chat as Markdown.
Attach multiple supported files; use drop, paste, and file picker paths.
Start a research Goal with tracked criteria/evidence and continue it, or request an Agent Swarm from chat.
Use composer shortcuts for connector check and portfolio analysis; chat UI displays tool calls and progress.
The composer exposes a live-runtime resume/halt control when live connector execution is available.
outputs_and_handoffs: Conversation, streamed activity/tool timeline, swarm status, research Goal panel, run completion cards and run previews.
Run cards link to /runs/:runId; session records stay in the sidebar.
external_or_market_limits: Agent action breadth depends on enabled native tools, configured model/provider, selected attachments, available data loaders, and any required connector/data credentials.
Cross-market actions are exposed through language examples and tools; this page itself is a general chat and does not provide a structured A-share opportunity list.
routes.ordinary_investor_placement: Primary entry. A compact summary of latest research/portfolio outcomes could live on a Mona workbench, while the conversation and advanced execution controls remain in this page.

major_user_operations: Manage portfolio source inclusion/order/labels/currency, connect a read-only broker profile, enter credentials into the OS vault, test/remove connections, and choose an account when required.
Import a local ExtraETF CSV with explicit position count and file-age limit; refresh sources; reconnect or retry failed sources.
Filter/search accounts and holdings; export portfolio CSV and a research snapshot JSON.
Enter target allocation percentages to generate a rebalance proposal; the UI has no order-submit button.
outputs_and_handoffs: Snapshot totals, daily change, pricing coverage, latest full snapshot time, account/holding allocation, positions, PnL/prices, refresh status, history chart, warnings, and rebalance delta proposal.
external_or_market_limits: Requires a configured, supported broker connector or a local import; adapter coverage/compatibility and read-only capability vary by profile.
Unpriced positions or failed accounts are shown as missing/excluded; conversion display offers USD/CNY/HKD/EUR and depends on snapshot FX data.
ExtraETF import accepts CSV, caps file size at 4 MB, and uses user-supplied position-count and max-age values.
routes.ordinary_investor_placement: Useful if the user has connected or imported data. Show total/coverage/warnings or top exposures in a workbench summary; keep connector, holdings, and rebalance details in this page.

routes.ordinary_investor_placement: Advanced research library; keep separate. A brief validated finding may be linked from a strategy/research result, but the catalogue itself is not a daily opportunity feed.
